name: govisit-destination
description: Find and inspect destination profiles and their published inventory. Destination updates are planned.

interface.longDescription: Find a destination and inspect its published GoVisit profile, places, activities, categories, highlights, and catalog statistics. Includes 13 public read skills for destination managers and requires no GoVisit API key. Reading a profile does not establish ownership. Destination updates are planned; this package cannot publish edits or make reservations.
